## Purpose and Runtime
OpenEMR is a PHP electronic health-record and medical-practice-management system: clinical records, scheduling, billing, patient portal, reporting, and interoperable health-data exchange. It is a server-rendered web application with substantial legacy PHP alongside newer namespaced services/controllers. Main runtime configuration and dependency wiring are in `config/app.php`, `config/services.php`, and `composer.json`. Node.js builds frontend assets/themes (`package.json`, `webpack.themes.js`).

## Request Entry Points and Bootstrap
Browser requests enter through `public/index.php` (with legacy root `index.php` also present), initialize common application state in `bootstrap.php`, and are mediated by the core kernel/routing bridge in `src/Core/Kernel.php` and `src/Core/OEHttpKernel.php`. The clinician-facing interface remains a collection of PHP endpoints under `interface/`, with tab-shell navigation at `interface/main/tabs/main.php`. CLI work is entered via `bin/console` and `bin/command-runner`.

## Clinical and Practice Workflow Core
Patient demographics, encounters, clinical history, forms, orders, prescriptions, documents, and scheduling are the primary transactional domain. Legacy UI endpoints call shared libraries and newer service classes; examples include `interface/patient_file/encounter/forms.php`, `interface/forms/vitals/save.php`, and `src/Services/PatientService.php`. The form subsystem is intentionally extensible and heterogeneous: form discovery/access is centralized in `src/Common/Forms/FormLocator.php` and `src/Common/Forms/EncounterFormAccess.php`, while individual form packages live under `interface/forms/`.

## Persistence, Sites, and Security Boundary
MySQL/MariaDB is the system of record, with base schema and long-lived upgrade scripts in `sql/database.sql` and `sql/*_upgrade.sql`; new migrations also exist in `db/Migrations/`. Deployment is site-oriented: `sites/default/config.php`, `sites/default/sqlconf.php`, and per-site document storage under `sites/default/documents/`. Database access is abstracted in newer code through `src/Common/Database/ConnectionManager.php`, but legacy SQL helpers remain in `library/sql.inc.php`. Authentication, MFA, ACL, OAuth keys, session handling, encryption, and audit logging are cross-cutting boundaries (`src/Common/Auth/AuthUtils.php`, `src/Common/Acl/AclMain.php`, `src/Common/Logging/EventAuditLogger.php`).

## APIs and Interoperability
REST APIs enter at `apis/dispatch.php`, use route definitions in `apis/routes/`, and execute through `src/RestControllers/ApiApplication.php` plus authorization/CORS/exception subscribers. The API layer maps resources to domain services, including FHIR R4 controllers such as `src/RestControllers/FHIR/FhirPatientRestController.php` and service implementations in `src/Services/FHIR/`. OAuth2/OpenID Connect and SMART-on-FHIR support are implemented in `src/Common/Auth/OpenIDConnect/` and `src/FHIR/SMART/`. Other exchange paths include HL7 orders/results, CCDA/CDA generation, QRDA quality export, and X12 billing.

## Background Work, Extensions, and External Services
Scheduled/background operations are registered and run via `src/Services/Background/BackgroundServiceRegistry.php` and `src/Services/Background/BackgroundServiceRunner.php`; CLI commands support the same operational boundary. Modules extend UI, events, routes, and services through bootstrap listeners, with shipped custom modules under `interface/modules/custom_modules/`; event contracts are under `src/Events/`. External integrations include SFTP claims submission (`src/Billing/BillingProcessor/SftpConnector.php`), payment gateways/webhooks (`src/PaymentProcessing/`), SMS/fax providers (`interface/modules/custom_modules/oe-module-faxsms/`), Redis-backed session locking, CouchDB document support, and external laboratory/pharmacy services.

## Deployment and Operations
Supported deployment packaging is Docker-centric, with production composition at `docker/production/docker-compose.yml` and image variants under `docker/release/` and `docker/flex/`. CI exercises Apache/Nginx, multiple PHP versions, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis Sentinel, Selenium, and Mailpit configurations under `ci/`. Health checks expose application dependencies through `meta/health/index.php` and `src/Health/HealthChecker.php`.
